title: Spec-check brief: look up existing decisions by topic with adj check TEXT

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The spec-check reported this as tool feedback (friction) on adj in spec check of S558, project ork, item S558:

add an adj find TEXT or key-substring search so a spec check can look up an existing decision key by topic

Evidence: `adj find "matrix.copy"` returned `adj: unknown command "find"`

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/roles/prompts/spec-check.md:76` decision-topic lookup.
- `internal/roles/prompts/spec-draft.md:42` decision-topic lookup guidance.
- `internal/roles/roles_test.go:777` TestSpecCheckPrompt and `internal/roles/roles_test.go:888` TestSpecDraftPrompt.
- `docs/state.md:699` recheck_slice one-shot retry wording.
- `docs/design.md:3121` spec-check lookup sentence (said adj find).
- `landed-changed/S559.md` (new), via slicer changelog add.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestSpecCheckPrompt`: requires adj check TEXT to find and reuse an existing decision key by topic, and rejects adj find.
- `TestSpecDraftPrompt`: requires the same topic lookup and reuse guidance, and rejects adj find.
- Both tests must fail against the old prompts before implementing the wording changes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Update TestSpecCheckPrompt and TestSpecDraftPrompt test-first for topic lookup with adj check TEXT and rejection of adj find.
2. Tell both spec roles to use adj check TEXT before inventing a decision key, reuse an existing key for the same topic, and never use adj find.
3. Correct docs/state.md: the first slice check after a retry reruns a red batch once; green batches remain cached. No runtime change.
4. Add the S559 changelog entry through slicer changelog add.
Not in this slice: adj features, runtime retry changes, or other role behavior.
